findings.title: Exact-case lookup allows blocked addresses to bypass the block
findings.body: The blocked-email lookup uses case-sensitive equality without normalizing either address. User.new_from_params assigns the submitted email unchanged, so a block for `block@spamfromhome.org` does not prevent registration with `block@SPAMFROMHOME.ORG`, even though it is the same mailbox (domain names are case-insensitive). Normalize addresses consistently when storing blocks and checking submissions, using the application's email normalization rules.

findings.title: Concurrent matches lose updates to match_count
findings.body: The match counter is updated through an unlocked read-modify-save sequence. Two requests matching the same blocked address can both read the same count and save the same incremented value, recording only one match instead of two. This makes the newly introduced statistics inaccurate under concurrent registration attempts. Increment the counter atomically in the database and update last_match_at in the same operation.
